Name: Craftable Magnetic Rings
Author: cosplaywrite
Description: Tired of the grind to level four of mining to get a ring that attracts foraged items to your farmer? Be tired no more! With this mod, you'll get a crafting recipe for the small magnet ring and magnet ring as you level up your mining skill waiting for that glowstone ring.

Manifest.Name: Craftable Magnetic Rings
Manifest.Description: Adds a crafing recipe for the small magnet ring and magnet ring to your crafting menu.
Manifest.Author: cosplaywrite
